note: Glyph templates for the burned-in overlay of the plain real-time BASS-II videos (PSI-25). Each bitmap is 15 rows x 25 columns of 0/1 (1 = ink), one glyph box of the character generator. Several bitmaps per character: the 720 px frame resamples the font at a different sub-pixel phase in each column and each video. Letters F U E L A I R N D were cut from the label line of PSI-25 Bhattacharjee videos B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8, B9, B10, B11, B12, B13, B15 (both files), B16, B19, B21, B22 (main views, readable files). Digits, '/' and ':' were cut from the clock line of the same videos, where the true text is known from counting the clock (one second per second, anchored on frames read by eye in B1, B3, B6, B9, B11, B13, B21 and on the readings that agree with that count in the other videos). '-' and '.' were cut from the FUEL and RAD fields. Each bitmap is the majority vote of all cells that agreed with it at Jaccard 0.8. Built with SI assistance (Claude Code), reviewed by the team. Templates carry no NASA logo or mission mark: they are the character shapes of a 1990s-style on-screen display.
